tags.name: Cities

tags.name: Carrier Routes

tags.name: Census Tracts

tags.name: Counties

tags.name: Places

tags.name: ZIP Codes (v1)

tags.name: ZIP Code H3
tags.description: H3 hexagon coverage of ZIP code boundaries: hexagon by index, hexagon or index at a location, and distance between two indexes.

post.summary: Get ZIP code boundaries by ZIP list
post.description: Request body is a JSON array of ZIP codes. Returns their boundaries; combine=true merges them into one geometry. Optional flags: showDetails, combine, showCenter, showEnvelope, fillHoles, showSpecial (include special/PO-box ZIPs), limit.

200.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or a JSON array for name/ID listings

401.description: Missing, invalid or inactive API key

post.summary: Find ZIP codes intersecting a WKT geometry
post.description: Request body is a WKT geometry (POLYGON, MULTIPOLYGON, etc.). Returns all ZIP code boundaries that intersect it. Optional flags: showDetails, combine, showCenter, showEnvelope, fillHoles, showSpecial (include special/PO-box ZIPs), limit.

200.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or a JSON array for name/ID listings
